submission.justification: No option can be verified as satisfying all hard requirements because the recorded work found no simulation time-resolution data and zero options with predictions satisfying the 1.5 ns limit. Among the candidates that are known to satisfy the GWP hard limit, Mixture-G2 has the lowest recorded GWP100 (15, versus 120 for Mixture-G3), and a 1 mm gap is within the allowed 1–3 mm range and is the smallest allowed gap. This is therefore the least-risk placeholder selection, not a fully validated compliant recommendation; the time-resolution requirement remains unverified and must be resolved with simulation or measurement before approval.

requirements.requirement: Mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected Mixture-G2, one of the three recorded allowed mixtures.

requirements.requirement: Time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.
requirements.evidence: No simulation time-resolution data were found; recorded values for Mixture-G2 and Mixture-G3 at 1, 2, and 3 mm are -1 placeholders, optimization_success=0, and num_options_satisfying_all_hard_requirements=0.

requirements.requirement: GWP100 of the mixture must not exceed 150.
requirements.evidence: Recorded GWP100_Mixture_G2 = 15, below the limit of 150.
Selected gap is 1 mm, equal to the lower bound of the allowed 1–3 mm interval.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: Best time resolution could not be determined because simulation_time_resolution_data_found=0 and best_time_resolution_Mixture_G2_ns=-1, best_time_resolution_Mixture_G3_ns=-1.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Mixture-G2 with a 1 mm gas gap.
